# Standards fixtures

Upstream artefacts that `tests/standards` checks PermDock against. `pnpm standards:fixtures` fetches them from the pinned sources in `scripts/fetch-standards-fixtures.ts`; never edit them by hand.

| File                                                                                       | Source                               | Licence                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cloudevents-1.0.2.schema.json`                                                            | CloudEvents 1.0.2 JSON Schema        | Apache-2.0                                                |
| `ocsf-1.3.0-*.json`                                                                        | OCSF 1.3.0 class definitions         | Apache-2.0                                                |
| `a2a-1.0.0.schema.json`                                                                    | A2A 1.0.0 JSON Schema                | Apache-2.0                                                |
| `arazzo-1.1.schema.json`                                                                   | Arazzo 1.1 schema `2026-04-15`       | Apache-2.0                                                |
| `rfc7520-jws.json`, `rfc8037-ed25519.json`, `rfc9421-ed25519.json`, `rfc7643-schemas.json` | Examples extracted from the RFC text | IETF Trust, code components under the Revised BSD Licence |
